name: EntitlementEntitlements
summary: The `entitlements` member body of the Entitlement replicated state: a prefix-varint delta count, the client's delta-count-zero branch (a strict zero-or-one presence flag and, when it is one, a prefix varint), then a prefix-varint element count and that many one-byte elements. Only the delta-count 0 branch has an instance in the recorded bundles, so the card pins the count to 0 and a non-zero count is refused rather than guessed.
purpose: Name the member layout that the two-level presence mask selects (group 0 member 0 of codec.entitlement-replicated-state), so the mask card references a record instead of carrying the container's layout itself.

fields.name: deltaCount
fields.note: The prefix-varint delta count read by 0x14279ec10 before it branches. It is 0 in the measured body; the client's non-zero branch (a chunked id-keyed map read by the same function) is recovered but has no instance, so the card bounds this field to 0 and the codec refuses anything else.

fields.name: delta
fields.note: The delta-count-zero branch of 0x143051a70: a strict zero-or-one presence byte through FUN_1461adf60 (which refuses any byte above 1) followed, when it is 1, by one prefix varint. Measured 01 0b.

fields.name: elements
fields.note: The prefix-varint element count and that many one-byte elements. 423 in the measured body. The client reads each element with the raw one-byte reader, so the element is a card of one u8 rather than a bare byte run; that keeps the generated struct free of an unnamed Vec<u8>.

evidence.ref: research/fixtures/wire/state-fragment-3133.hex: 00 01 0b then a7 06 then 423 bytes; the body re-encodes byte-exactly.
Member reader 0x14279ec10 and its delta-count-zero branch 0x143051a70 (build 30fe6461).
